name: code-taste
description: Engineering judgment for architecture, boundaries, naming, maintainability, documentation, and code review.

interface.shortDescription: Architecture, boundaries, naming, maintainability, and review
interface.longDescription: Applies judgment-first engineering principles before implementation: clarify the original requirement, control complexity, shape models and boundaries, and review code at the appropriate depth.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use code-taste to clarify the requirement, choose the appropriate review depth, and assess the design before implementation.
